messages:
Megan L.: quick async standup — short updates on audits/IAM/KMS.

Megan L.: what I did: completed inventory of long-lived service keys, tagged assets in the audit sheet, drafted narrow-scope policy changes for ops and infra roles. Blockers: waiting on the exemptions spreadsheet from the platform team (platform@) to finalize role narrows. Today: will prep PR and schedule KMS dry-run window.

Raj P.: ran nightly SAST + dependency scan on staging. Found medium issue in transcode-lib (CVE-2026-101) — created patch PR #342. No expected compatibility issues but would like an extra review before any canary. Added unit test covering the fix.

Olivia K.: looked at #342. Two logging nitpicks and one assertion edge-case in tests. I'll queue a quick CI rerun after fixes. CI has a flake in integ-db-tests — re-running now :arrows_counterclockwise:

Tim S.: consolidated legacy IAM roles list and marked candidates for deprecation. Uploaded CSV to TICKET-4821. Question: is `legacy-data-processor` still required by Billing for backfill? @Megan L. can you confirm retention requirements? :thinking_face:

Megan L.: Tim — spoke to billing; they need `legacy-data-processor` retained for 30 days post-migration. Scheduling deprecation for 2026-05-10 and noting in the ticket.

Andre M.: KMS rotation dry-run plan: doing a small staging batch at 15:30 UTC using the new rotate workflow. Command for traceability: `gcloud kms keys versions create --key my-staging-key --location=global` then `gcloud kms keys versions destroy` (dry-run variant). I'll post logs to the ticket. Might need oncall assistance if services need quick key rollback.

security-bot: Weekly compliance snapshot uploaded: https://redwood-internal.s3.aws/reports/compliance/weekly-2026-04-07.pdf — includes key inventory, open findings, and last rotation timestamps.

Olivia K.: Raj — after your fix and my nits, I can approve. If CI goes green, propose canary to eu-west-1 tomorrow at 08:00 UTC.

Raj P.: thanks @Olivia K. — pushing fixes now, adding changelog note, will ping when CI green.

Megan L.: blockers recap: (1) platform exemption list needed for IAM narrows, (2) extra reviewer on #342, (3) oncall cover for KMS dry-run. Action items: I'll follow up with platform (platform@), add deprecation date to TICKET-4821, and coordinate dry-run window with oncall rotation. If you want to join the dry-run send time availability here.

Tim S.: noted — I'll prune deprecated roles after 2026-05-10 and update the inventory. :white_check_mark:

Andre M.: posting a heads-up to oncall channel now. Will share runbook steps and rollback commands in the ticket.

Olivia K.: setting a calendar reminder for the canary. Good session plan!

Megan L.: thanks all — summary will be attached to the ticket. Ping me here for dry-run slot or if you want to pair on the canary. :pray:
